native.title: Add native mFi device {name}
native.description: This publisher advertises {ports} physical ports. mFi will own their sensors and relay switches under separate port devices. Only continue for a new installation with no existing MQTT/companion counters to preserve. Use the explicit migration workflow for existing installations. Renaming ports in HA will not change hardware labels.

data.confirm_new: This is a new installation; no legacy entity or energy-history migration is required

user.title: Select an existing mFi MQTT device
user.description: MQTT keeps ownership of your power sensors and relays. This companion adds energy counters without changing them.

confirm.title: Create energy counters for {device}
confirm.description: Detected {ports} power sources (model: {model}). New counters start at zero. Exclude ports whose existing energy helpers you want to keep. Before enabling, verify the running mfi-mqtt-client refreshes unchanged power, advertises expiration and per-channel availability, and that legacy retained numeric power has been cleared through a separately approved migration. This integration cannot verify those prerequisites from entity metadata. No device or broker changes will be made.

data.freshness_confirmed: I verified power freshness and retained-power cleanup
data.excluded_sources: Ports to exclude from new energy counters
data.model_confirmed: I confirm this unrecognized model is an mFi device with compatible power sources

error.invalid_device: Select an available mFi MQTT device.
error.invalid_source: Select power sources belonging to this device.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm this prerequisite before creating counters.
error.storage_error: The initial energy checkpoint could not be saved. Check Home Assistant's storage and logs, then retry.

abort.invalid_native_descriptor: The native mFi descriptor is malformed, unsupported, or does not match its topic.
abort.migration_pending: This device is reserved by an ownership migration. Resume or roll back that migration instead of creating another entry.
abort.mqtt_required: Configure Home Assistant's MQTT integration first.
abort.no_devices: No compatible mFi MQTT power sensors were found. Wait for MQTT discovery and check sensor metadata.
abort.already_configured: This device already has an mFi energy companion.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this device is already in progress. Finish or cancel it before recovering an existing companion onto this device.
abort.device_removed: The selected MQTT device was removed.
abort.ambiguous_sources: More power sources were found than physical ports. Resolve obsolete MQTT discovery entries before setup; do not delete broker records without approval.

menu_options.rebind: Rebind an existing counter to a replacement source
menu_options.device: Recover after an upstream device identity change

exclude.description: Excluded counters stop accumulating. Existing counters keep their identity and saved totals but become unavailable. No energy is backfilled when re-enabled.

rebind.description: Use only when you have identified the same physical port after an upstream identity change. The counter keeps its total and history. The old source is ignored, not deleted. Unavailable time is not backfilled.

ignore.description: Ignore obsolete discovery sources without deleting their MQTT entities or broker records. Bound sources must be excluded or rebound instead.

device.description: Use only after a hostname or device identity change for the same physical mFi device. Counters and history are preserved, but all missing ports must then be mapped explicitly using Rebind. No port labels are matched automatically.

data.same_device: I confirm this is the same physical device with compatible power freshness

error.storage_error: The changes could not be committed. Check storage and the Repairs notice before retrying.
error.invalid_source: Choose an eligible unbound source on this device or a valid counter. A replacement device must not already have another companion or a pending setup. Cancel its pending Add Integration flow before recovering an existing companion.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the physical device before changing its source.

abort.not_loaded: Load the integration successfully before changing its options.
abort.native_mapping: Native ports use provisioned physical identities. Legacy source rebinding is not available for this device.
abort.runtime_changed: The integration stopped or reloaded while this request was waiting. Reopen Configure after it has loaded; the stale request was not applied.
abort.no_replacements: No unbound power sources are available on this device.

native.title: Native mFi publisher needs attention
native.description:
{detail}

Check the provisioned device identity, publisher version, and MQTT configuration. Control and energy remain unavailable while the contract is invalid or conflicting. Do not reset existing counters to recover.

storage.title: mFi energy checkpoint needs attention
storage.description:
{detail}

Energy reporting is suspended rather than resetting counters or reporting unsaved totals. Check available disk space, permissions, and logs. Restore missing or corrupt checkpoint files from a consistent Home Assistant backup, then reload the integration. Do not replace an existing total with zero.

sources.title: mFi power source bindings need attention
sources.description:
{detail}

Check the MQTT source entities. Use the mFi integration's Configure menu to rebind a known physical port or ignore obsolete unbound sources. Existing totals and MQTT entities are preserved.
